content.title: Morning Harvest Closure | Inventory Progress and Companion Return
content.summary: A rooftop gardener fills one crate and returns with a companion dog. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult, route and container remain fixed. + Every harvest action changes visible inventory. + Close views prove physical detachment and placement. + Animals remain secondary environmental witnesses. + The final route return carries the completed harvest.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult rooftop gardener in a cream shirt carrying an empty blue crate while one pigeon and a small dog cross the path. Use one hand close-up to prove the final pepper detaches from its stem. The gardener carries the filled crate back along the opening path while the dog follows at a safe distance.
